senses.gloss:
Vaivasvata
(‘son of Vivasvān’)
------------------------------------------
Āditya—Sun-god—is known as Viva-svān. His wife was सṁज्ञा. वैवस्वत was their son. He is also known as वैवस्वत-मनु and Śrāddhadeva.
He is the seventh in the series of मनुस्. It is his rule, called मन्वन्तर, that is going on now.
